title: Mom Realizes She Killed Her Own Baby
description:
A mom was arrested in Albuquerque, New Mexico after allegedly causing the death of her 4-month-old child. Police took Christina Bennett, 31, into custody after responding to an urgent 911 call. On arrival, the bodycam video shows Bennett refusing to let go of the child and refusing medical care for the infant. Witnesses said the 31-year-old came knocking on their door asking for a "lighter" before mentioning the baby was "dead." Investigators later revealed a laundry list of parental issues stemming from the mother of three including an active felony warrant for child abuse. Bennett was later sentenced to a decade in prison after pleading no contest to multiple charges. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
